fields.retrieval_id: Optional ID returned by a consented search. When supplied, it must identify a stored session and the rated evidence ID/rank must have appeared in that session.
fields.evidence_id: Canonical chunk_id resolving to a record in the active corpus.
fields.rank: 1-based displayed rank; must match the stored retrieval session when retrieval_id is supplied.
fields.helpful: Boolean user-reported usefulness label; not a clinical outcome.

feedback_type.reranking: Only consented evidence_retrieval feedback tied to a stored consented search is included in usefulness reranking. Direct submissions and post_therapy reports are stored separately and do not affect retrieval scores.

fields.consent_status: Must be explicitly supplied as consented, granted, or true; there is no implicit consent default.
fields.query_hash: SHA-256 of the normalized query; raw query text is not stored in retrieval sessions.
fields.user_comment: Optional free text up to 1000 characters. Email, common phone, 12-digit identifier, and date patterns receive best-effort redaction before storage; names and all PHI are not reliably detected. Comments are not returned in the API response.

interpretation: Feedback records reported usefulness or reported post-therapy observations. They are not independently verified evidence of clinical correctness, safety, or patient benefit.
privacy_and_governance: API_KEY optionally protects all API routes except root, health, and API docs. Feedback and retrieval sessions expire according to FEEDBACK_RETENTION_DAYS (default 365 days). Comment redaction is best-effort and is not a substitute for excluding PHI.
